entries.title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted

entries.title: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway

entries.title: What next for Lindsay Clancy?

entries.title: Tate brothers officially indicted with trafficking and sex crimes in Romania

entries.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
entries.summary: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.
